Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a feature addition; current main contains the Gateway foundations but lacks these Control UI surfaces. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The UI adapters and bundled Access plugin appropriately reuse the existing membership authority; the simplification pass found no concrete need for replacement architecture.
